title: Effects of Film-Based Music Therapy on Anxiety and Heart Rate Among Chinese Young Adults
author: Wen Li

steps.title: Recruit eligible participants
steps.instruction: Identify and recruit university students who meet the eligibility criteria and obtain informed consent.

steps.title: Randomly assign to groups
steps.instruction: Using a simple random allocation procedure, assign participants in equal numbers to one of three parallel groups: (1) Eastern Imagery Music Therapy with large‑language‑model generated verbal guidance, (2) Standard Music Therapy with conventional relaxation‑oriented verbal guidance, or (3) Music‑Only Relaxation with no verbal guidance.

steps.title: Collect baseline measurements
steps.instruction: Immediately before the intervention, have each participant complete the State subscale of the State–Trait Anxiety Inventory (STAI‑S, 20‑80 range), the Positive Affect subscale of the PANAS (10 items), the Negative Affect subscale of the PANAS (10 items), and record mean heart rate using a smartphone‑based photoplethysmography method.

steps.title: Prepare listening environment
steps.instruction: Set up a quiet classroom, seat participants comfortably, ask them to close their eyes, and ensure the environment is free of distractions.

steps.title: Conduct music listening session
steps.instruction: Play the assigned curated music for a single 25–30‑minute session. Deliver verbal guidance during the session if the participant is in the Eastern Imagery or Standard Music Therapy groups; the Eastern group receives LLM‑generated imagery‑evoking guidance, the Standard group receives conventional relaxation guidance, and the Music‑Only group receives no verbal guidance.

substeps.instruction: Start timing; session length should be between 25 and 30 minutes.
Researcher delivers the appropriate verbal guidance continuously throughout the music playback for guided groups.

steps.title: Collect post‑intervention measurements
steps.instruction: Immediately after the session, repeat the same assessments as at baseline: STAI‑S, PANAS positive affect, PANAS negative affect, and heart‑rate recording via the same smartphone photoplethysmography method.

steps.title: Calculate outcome changes
steps.instruction: For each participant, compute the change (post‑intervention minus pre‑intervention) in State Anxiety score, Positive Affect score, Negative Affect score, and mean heart rate.
